Further Announcement – Delay in Submission of the Annual Report for Financial Year 2025/26

Further to its announcement dated 8 October 2026, Exterminators PLC hereby notifies the Colombo Stock Exchange and its shareholders that submission of the Annual Report for the financial year ended 31 March 2026 will be delayed beyond the previously indicated date of 31 October 2026.
reqBaseAnnouncement.title: CORPORATE DISCLOSURE
